data.what_done: Isolated a concrete code path that yields the exact UI mismatch you described between task display and subagent session agent name.
data.approach_taken: Traced agent name resolution from config/frontmatter through Agent.merge into TaskTool session creation.
data.challenges_faced: Needed a deterministic explanation that produces a mismatch without relying on timing or navigation artifacts.
data.how_solved: Found that the optional `name` field in agent configs overrides the agent’s runtime name, which TaskTool uses for session creation while the task UI uses the subagent_type string.
data.reasoning: If any subagent has `name` set (intentionally or by copied frontmatter), its sessions will display that name (possibly your primary agent) even though the task display shows the requested subagent key.
next_steps: Check the affected subagent’s frontmatter/opencode.json for a `name` field and remove or align it.
Optionally harden TaskTool to use params.subagent_type for session agent name to avoid config drift.
